entries.name: Water under lock
entries.warning: Lantern Market · the concession is closing the kitchen's water feed. A shutoff crew is on its way.
entries.success: The kitchen taps run again. Neighbors carry bowls back to the counter; the ration is still small, but the water is shared.
entries.failure: The water feed locks. The kitchen stops serving while Nella prepares another bypass. The controls reset shortly.

entries.name: Memories running warm
entries.warning: Glass Steps · a cooling line has ruptured. Amber circles mark pressure vents; step out before they discharge.
entries.success: Coolant reaches the witness shelves. Residents return the rescued records to cold storage; the duplicate cabinets must wait.
entries.failure: The cooling circuit trips. Residents move the remaining records by hand while the safety valves reset.

entries.name: The heat collectors
entries.warning: Copper Walk · debt wardens are reclaiming the heat bypass. Break their locks before the occupied risers go cold.
entries.success: Warmth returns to the occupied risers. The repair crew sits down to eat while the shared feed holds.
entries.failure: The collectors seal the diverter. The flats go cold; Merek's crew starts cutting a new access seal.

entries.name: A warning without sound
entries.warning: Listening Courts · floodwater is grounding the warning circuit. Restore both relays and avoid the marked electrical surges.
entries.success: The lamps and handrails agree again. Neighbors return to the planters, with someone watching the waterline.
entries.failure: The warning circuit goes dark. Neighbors carry the alarm door to door while the battery resets.

entries.name: The last lift is closing
entries.warning: Last Connection · enforcement is invalidating service passes. Reopen the counters and hold the skyway for the late shift.
entries.success: Service passes register again. The stranded shift starts moving, and the platform has a departure to announce.
entries.failure: The counter rejects the late shift. Ivo holds the passengers together while the local override resets.
